'''Bastian Winkelhaus Corulag Operatives''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds62.htm Corulag Operatives], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228055131/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds62.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
